ambient_events: The shunting loco couples up with a crash and a hiss of ancient brakes.
A flatcar of scrap rolls past, loaded past any sane limit, and slows to a stop.
description: The Yards' rail terminus, where a single working locomotive shunts flatcars of scrap and cargo out to wherever rails still run. The yardmaster keeps his office in a dead signal box here.
name: The Railhead
